candidate: Track O's display-text grant + Track W's obligation-rank bound (branch worktree-agent-a2b36768e355862f0, commit 432f23c)
question: Track W bounded Track O's display-text foreground grant by the artwork's own identity ordering: a family may take the foreground over anything it already outranks, and over nothing it does not. That keeps 6/6 of the endorsed foreground flips, recovers birdsofprey (strong x4), and cuts blast radius from 30.7% to 23.6% of 140 cases. Items 1-4 ask whether the rule's remaining collateral survives review. Items 5-9 are separate standing questions this arm's sweep and bisection data can answer cheaply.

method.after: Items 1-5 are REAL extractions with the candidate runtime, matching the `w-o-rank` sweep exactly. Items 6-8 are LEGAL on-slate treatments — arrangements the UNMODIFIED runtime materialized and scored for that artwork, selected by exact hex match and highest relationUtility, never hand-written.
